name: rag-golden-smoke
description: Minimal synthetic smoke dataset for baseline RAG pipeline verification (ingest/chunk/retrieve/generate interfaces). Not representative of production or domain corpora.
source: Synthetic examples authored for repository baseline testing; no external/customer/regulated documents included.
limitations: Very small sample size (3 cases); suitable only for smoke/regression checks, not quality claims.
Synthetic, plain-text content only; does not cover PDF/HTML/DOCX/EML, OCR, tables, multi-tenant data, or financial-services terminology.
Expected answers/evidence are illustrative and may not capture all acceptable grounded responses.
No human adjudication study; relevance judgments are provisional.
